title: PickPal Booking & Order Management Guide - How Booking Works on PickPal
content: PickPal provides a streamlined process for creating customer errand requests, shopping orders, and shop service appointments.

title: PickPal Booking & Order Management Guide - Creating an Order / Request
content:
1. **Initiating a Request**:
   - Customers log into the PickPal Customer Portal and navigate to **Home** or **Categories**.
   - For custom shopping or errands, customers click **+ New Request**.
   - For pre-configured services, customers select a service card (e.g., Electrician, Plumber, Salon) from the marketplace.

2. **Defining Order Details**:
   - **Items / Services**: Specified with names, quantities (`qty`), and optional price estimates.
   - **Budget Cap (`budgetCap`)**: Set by the customer to constrain maximum spending for custom shopping runs.
   - **Location**: Picked via interactive map or selected from saved customer addresses.
   - **Attachments**: Customers can upload text descriptions, reference images, item photos, or voice notes.

3. **Firestore Order Object Creation**:
   - Orders are saved in Cloud Firestore under `/orders/{orderId}`.
   - Initial order parameters include:
     - `customerId`: Authenticated user UID.
     - `customerName`: Name of requesting customer.
     - `category`: Service category (`grocery`, `pharmacy`, `hardware`, `electronics`, `other`).
     - `status`: Set initially to `"searching_worker"`.
     - `totalAmount`: Initial calculated order subtotal.
     - `paymentStatus`: `"pending"` or `"paid"`.

title: PickPal Booking & Order Management Guide - Worker Assignment & Order Lifecycle
content:
1. **Worker Matching & Dispatch**:
   - Available online workers receive nearby job notifications.
   - Matching algorithm ranks offers based on proximity distance (in km) and worker rating score.
   - **Atomic Claiming**: A worker clicks **Claim Job**. Firestore transaction ensures only one worker can successfully claim the job record.

2. **Complete Order Status Progression**:
   - `searching_worker`: Order posted; searching for nearby available workers.
   - `worker_assigned`: Worker claimed job; `workerId` and `workerName` attached.
   - `travelling`: Worker traveling to merchant store or customer address.
   - `arrived`: Worker physically arrived at store or customer location.
   - `in_progress`: Worker picking items or performing home service.
   - `checkout_approvals`: Worker submitted final bill items for customer approval if budget changed.
   - `delivering`: Worker out for delivery with items.
   - `completed`: Order delivered, service completed, wallet funds settled.
   - `cancelled`: Order terminated by customer or system prior to completion.

title: PickPal Booking & Order Management Guide - Order Tracking & Reviews
content:
- Customers track live worker GPS coordinates (`workerLiveLat`, `workerLiveLng`) on the **Track** screen.
- Upon completion, customers can leave a star rating (1–5 stars) and review comment for the worker or shop vendor.

title: PickPal Cancellation Policy Guide - Cancellation Rules & Policies
content: PickPal implements cancellation rules for errand orders and salon appointment tokens based on order status and progress.

title: PickPal Cancellation Policy Guide - 1. Errand & Shopping Order Cancellations
content:
- **Allowed States**: Customers can cancel an order when it is in the `searching_worker` or `worker_assigned` state prior to the worker arriving at the store or starting the service.
- **Cancellation Execution**:
  - The order status in Firestore updates to `cancelled`.
  - If the order was pre-paid via wallet balance, a refund transaction (`type: "credit"`, `description: "Refund for cancelled order"`) is issued to the customer's wallet.
- **Post-In Progress Restrictions**: Once an order moves to `in_progress` (worker is actively purchasing items or performing doorstep repair), cancellation via the app is restricted to protect worker effort and purchased goods.

title: PickPal Cancellation Policy Guide - 2. Salon Appointment Token Cancellations
content:
- **Allowed States**: Customers holding a confirmed salon or shop service queue token (`Q-18`) can cancel their queue spot at any time prior to shop check-in.
- **Cancellation Execution**:
  - Customer opens their digital ticket (`AppointmentToken.tsx`) and clicks **Cancel Ticket**.
  - Confirms prompt: *"Are you sure you want to cancel this appointment queue spot?"*.
  - Calls `ShopService.cancelAppointment(appointment.id)`, updating appointment status to `cancelled`.
  - The live shop queue recalculates; `peopleWaiting` decrements, reducing wait times for remaining queued customers.

title: PickPal Cancellation Policy Guide - 3. Refunds for Cancelled Bookings
content:
- Refunds for cancelled bookings are credited directly back to the customer's PickPal Digital Wallet balance (`/wallets/{userId}`).
- Refund transaction records display `status: "success"` and reference the cancelled order ID.

title: PickPal Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) - Q: What is PickPal?
content: **A**: PickPal is a hyperlocal quick-commerce marketplace and on-demand service delivery platform connecting customers with local shop vendors, verified technicians, and delivery partners for rapid sub-30 minute shopping errands, doorstep repairs, and salon queue tokens.

title: PickPal Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) - Q: Which services can come to my home?
content: **A**: Home Services include Electrician, Plumber, Carpenter, Painter, AC Repair, Appliance Repair, Cleaning, Gardening, custom Grocery/Errand shopping, and Parcel Pick & Drop. Verified technicians travel directly to your location.

title: PickPal Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) - Q: How do shop visit services work?
content: **A**: For shop visit services (Salon, Beautician, Barber, Spa, Laundry, Tailoring, Clinics), you can either book a scheduled appointment slot or request a digital walk-in queue token from your mobile phone.

title: PickPal Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) - Q: How does salon token booking work?
content: **A**: When you book a salon token, PickPal issues a digital ticket with a unique token number (e.g. `Q-18`). The app tracks the current serving token in real-time, calculates how many people are ahead of you, and estimates your wait time (20 minutes per person ahead). You arrive at the salon when your turn approaches and scan your OTP/QR code.

title: PickPal Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) - Q: How do I track my order or worker?
content: **A**: Open the **Track** screen in the PickPal app. You will see an interactive Leaflet map displaying your worker's live location, route navigation, turn-by-turn status updates, and dynamic estimated arrival time.

title: PickPal Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) - Q: How do I book a custom errand or grocery run?
content: **A**: Click **+ New Request** on the home dashboard. Enter the items you need, set your budget limit (`budgetCap`), choose your address, add optional voice or image notes, and submit. Nearby online delivery partners will bid or claim your request.

title: PickPal Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) - Q: How do I cancel a booking or token?
content: **A**: You can cancel an active errand request in `searching_worker` or `worker_assigned` status via the order details view. For salon tokens, open your digital ticket and click **Cancel Ticket** to release your spot in line.

title: PickPal Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) - Q: What payment methods are supported on PickPal?
content: **A**: PickPal supports payments via the PickPal Digital Wallet, UPI apps (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm), Credit/Debit Cards, QR Code scans, and Net Banking.

title: PickPal Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) - Q: How does the Emergency SOS button work?
content: **A**: If you ever feel unsafe during an order, click the Emergency SOS button. PickPal instantly broadcasts your live GPS coordinates, order ID, and user details to platform control room administrators for immediate emergency assistance.

title: PickPal Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) - Q: How do workers get verified on PickPal?
content: **A**: Workers must submit government identification (Aadhaar card front/back, PAN card), a clear live selfie, address details, and skills. Platform admins audit these documents before approving the worker's account to accept jobs.

title: PickPal Home Services Guide - Overview of Home Services
content: Home Services on PickPal are on-demand services where verified delivery partners or skilled technicians travel directly to the customer's specified address.

title: PickPal Home Services Guide - Available Doorstep Services
content:
- **Household Repairs & Maintenance**: Electrician, Plumber, Carpenter, Painter, AC Repair, Appliance Repair, Gardening.
- **Home Cleaning**: Full house deep cleaning, kitchen cleaning, bathroom sanitization.
- **Custom Errands & Shopping Runs**: Instant grocery purchasing, emergency medicine pick-up, retail errands, local parcel pick & drop.

title: PickPal Home Services Guide - Booking Flow for Home Services
content:
1. **Service Selection or Custom Request**:
   - Customers can browse by category on the PickPal Home dashboard or click **+ New Request** for custom errands.
   - For custom shopping, customers enter item names, quantities, preferred store names, and a budget limit (`budgetCap`).
   - Customers can attach voice notes, photos of shopping lists, or instructions.

2. **Location Selection**:
   - Customers select their delivery location using an interactive Leaflet map pin or saved addresses.
   - The system records exact GPS coordinates (`customerLat`, `customerLng`).

3. **Worker Assignment & Dispatch Algorithm**:
   - When a request is created, it enters the status `searching_worker`.
   - PickPal's distance and rating scoring algorithm broadcasts the job offer feed to nearby active workers who are **Online** and within their configured operating radius.
   - The first eligible worker to claim the job is assigned atomically in Firestore to prevent duplicate worker claims.

4. **Order Progress & Navigation**:
   - Once assigned, the order transitions through status steps:
     1. `worker_assigned`: Worker claimed job.
     2. `travelling`: Worker traveling to shop/customer.
     3. `arrived`: Worker arrived at store or customer doorstep.
     4. `in_progress` / `checkout_approvals`: Worker purchasing items or performing repair.
     5. `delivering`: Worker en route to doorstep with items.
     6. `completed`: Order delivered and finalized.

5. **Real-Time Live Map Tracking**:
   - Customers can open the **Track** screen to view live Leaflet map navigation.
   - Workers stream real-time location coordinates (`workerLiveLat`, `workerLiveLng`, `workerLiveAt`).
   - The UI calculates and displays a dynamic estimated time of arrival (ETA counter) and turn-by-turn route path.

6. **In-App Communication & AI Substitutions**:
   - Customers and workers communicate via real-time in-app chat (`/messages`).
   - If a requested item is out of stock, the worker can propose a substitute with price adjustment.
   - Integrated Google Gemini AI suggests store-brand or budget-friendly product alternatives to assist shoppers.

title: PickPal Payments & Wallet Guide - PickPal Wallet Architecture
content: PickPal features an integrated digital wallet system (`/wallets/{userId}`) that enables instant payments, wallet top-ups, transaction logging, and automated worker payout settlements.

title: PickPal Payments & Wallet Guide - User Wallet Balances
content:
- Every customer and worker profile maintains a real-time `walletBalance` field.
- Wallet balances update instantly when funds are added, orders are completed, or refunds are processed.

title: PickPal Payments & Wallet Guide - Transaction Logs & Payment Types
content:
All financial transactions are stored in `/wallets/{userId}/transactions` with fields:
- `type`: `"credit"` (adding money, earning) or `"debit"` (paying for order/booking).
- `amount`: Monetary value in ₹ (INR).
- `description`: Transaction memo (e.g., "Paid for Order #12345", "Added money via UPI").
- `paymentMethod`: Supported options include `UPI`, `Card`, `QR Code`, `Net Banking`, `Wallet Settlement`.
- `status`: `"success"`, `"pending"`, `"failed"`.
- `referenceId`: Unique transaction ID or external payment gateway reference.

title: PickPal Payments & Wallet Guide - Payment Gateways & Top-Up Methods
content:
- Customers top up their wallet balance using the **Add Money** interface (`AddMoneyModal.tsx`).
- Supported modes: UPI Apps (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm), Credit/Debit Cards, QR Code scan, Net Banking.
- *Gateway Status*: The payment UI modal and service stub (`payment-gateway.service.ts`) are fully implemented; live Razorpay webhooks are scheduled for production gateway integration.

title: PickPal Payments & Wallet Guide - Invoices & Receipts
content:
- Upon order completion, PickPal generates an itemized PDF invoice record (`InvoiceRecord`).
- Captures: `orderId`, `customerId`, `customerName`, `workerName`, `storeName`, `category`, `date`, `amount`, `commission`, `gst`, `totalPaid`, `items`, `pdfUrl`.

title: PickPal Payments & Wallet Guide - Payment Statuses
content:
- `paymentStatus: "paid"`: Funds successfully debited from customer wallet/card.
- `paymentStatus: "pending"`: Payment authorization in progress.
- `paymentStatus: "refunded"`: Order cancelled; funds credited back to customer wallet.

title: PickPal Safety & Emergency Features Guide - PickPal Emergency Safety Infrastructure
content: Customer and worker safety is a top priority on the PickPal platform. PickPal includes a one-tap Emergency SOS escalation system integrated with platform control room administrators.

title: PickPal Safety & Emergency Features Guide - One-Tap Emergency SOS Signal
content:
1. **SOS Trigger Interface**:
   - Prominently accessible on customer active order tracking screens, worker job screens, and top navigation bars.
   - Designed for instant activation during emergencies, harassment, accidents, or safety threats.

2. **Data Broadcast Payload**:
   - Clicking the Emergency SOS button immediately captures real-time telemetry:
     - `userId`: Authenticated user UID.
     - `userName`: Full name of user broadcasting alert.
     - `role`: User role (`customer` or `worker`).
     - `orderId`: Active order ID (if SOS is triggered during an order).
     - `lat`, `lng`: Live GPS latitude and longitude coordinates.
     - `reason`: Primary safety incident category.
     - `note`: Optional emergency description.
     - `status`: Set to `"open"`.
     - `createdAt`: ISO timestamp.

3. **Firestore Event Dispatch**:
   - Pushes an emergency record directly into the `/sos_events/{sosId}` collection in Cloud Firestore.

4. **Control Room Monitoring & Admin Alerting**:
   - Platform Administrators monitoring the **Control Room Portal** (`ControlDashboard.tsx`, `ControlSidebar.tsx`) receive real-time visual and audible emergency alerts.
   - Admins can inspect the broadcast coordinates on an interactive emergency map, contact local authorities, call emergency services, and mark the event as `resolved`.

title: PickPal Safety & Emergency Features Guide - Security & Privacy Protections
content:
- All user data and location broadcasts are encrypted and restricted by Firestore Security Rules (`firestore.rules`).
- SOS events can only be created by authenticated users and resolved by validated platform administrators.

title: PickPal Salon Token Queue System Guide - Overview of Salon Tokens
content: The PickPal Digital Salon Token System allows customers to join virtual waiting queues for local salons, barber shops, spas, and clinics without physically standing in line at the venue.

title: PickPal Salon Token Queue System Guide - Token Generation & Structure
content:
- Upon booking a queue spot at a shop, PickPal generates an appointment token document in Firestore (`/appointments/{appointmentId}`).
- Each token features a sequential queue identifier such as `Q-18` (where `18` represents the token sequence number for the shop on that date).
- Associated record fields include: `shopId`, `shopName`, `serviceName`, `staffName`, `date`, `timeSlot`, `queueNumber`, `otp`, `status` (`confirmed`, `in_progress`, `completed`, `cancelled`).

title: PickPal Salon Token Queue System Guide - Live Queue Tracking & Math
content:
The customer's `AppointmentToken` view subscribes in real time to the shop's live queue state (`ShopService.subscribeQueueState` listening to `/shop_queues/{shopId}_{date}`):

1. **Current Serving Token (`currentRunningToken`)**:
   - Displays the token currently inside the service chair (e.g., `Q-12`).

2. **People Ahead (`peopleAhead`)**:
   - Calculated dynamically as:
     $$\text{peopleAhead} = \max(0, \text{myTokenNum} - \text{currentRunningToken})$$
   - Example: If your token is `Q-18` and current serving is `Q-12`, there are $18 - 12 = 6$ people ahead of you.

3. **Estimated Wait Time Calculation (`waitTime`)**:
   - PickPal uses a standard formula of **20 minutes per person ahead**:
     $$\text{Est. Wait Time (mins)} = \text{peopleAhead} \times 20$$
   - Example: For 6 people ahead, estimated wait time is $6 \times 20 = 120\text{ minutes}$.
   - If token status is `completed`, wait time displays `"Served"`.
   - If token status is `cancelled`, wait time displays `"Cancelled"`.

title: PickPal Salon Token Queue System Guide - Check-In Verification & Arrival at Shop
content:
- **QR Code & Verification OTP**: Each token contains a unique Check-In Verification Code (OTP) and a scannable digital QR code.
- **Shop Navigation**: Customers can click "Navigate to Shop" to open Google Maps directions to the shop location.
- **Scan at Shop**: Upon arrival at the salon, shop staff scan the customer's QR code or verify the OTP to mark the appointment as `in_progress`.

title: PickPal Salon Token Queue System Guide - Queue Updates & Ticket Cancellation
content:
- As shop staff complete appointments, the `currentRunningToken` increments, automatically reducing the `peopleAhead` count and estimated wait time on all waiting customers' mobile screens.
- Customers can cancel their queue spot at any time prior to check-in by clicking **Cancel Ticket**, freeing up the queue for others.

title: PickPal Services Overview - PickPal Service Catalog
content: PickPal provides a hyperlocal quick-commerce marketplace and on-demand service delivery platform. Services are grouped into four primary operational categories: **Home Services**, **Shopping Errands**, **Pick & Drop Services**, and **Personal/Shop Services**.

title: PickPal Services Overview - Service Categories & Groups
content:
1. **Hardware & Maintenance (`hardware`)** — Home & Technical Repair Services:
   - **Electrician**: Wiring, fixture installation, fuse repairs, appliance socket troubleshooting.
   - **Plumber**: Pipe leaks, tap replacements, drainage unblocking, sanitary fitting.
   - **Carpenter**: Furniture assembly, door lock repairs, woodwork restoration.
   - **Painter**: Wall touch-ups, full room painting, exterior waterproofing.
   - **AC Repair**: Air conditioner servicing, gas refilling, filter cleaning, cooling issues.
   - **Appliance Repair**: Washing machine, refrigerator, microwave, and TV repair.

2. **Shopping Errands (`grocery`, `pharmacy`, `electronics`, `other`)**:
   - **Grocery**: Sub-30 minute delivery of fresh produce, dairy, packaged foods, household essentials.
   - **Medicine**: Prescription and OTC pharmaceutical fulfillment from licensed local chemist shops.
   - **Electronics**: Mobile accessories, cables, chargers, small electronic gadgets.
   - **Fashion**: Clothing, footwear, local boutique retail pickups.
   - **Pet Supplies**: Pet food, toys, grooming products from local pet stores.
   - **Gifts**: Flowers, chocolates, greeting cards, custom gift items.

3. **Pick & Drop Courier Services (`pickup`)**:
   - **Parcel**: Point-to-point courier delivery of physical goods within the city.
   - **Documents**: Secure transport of confidential paperwork, legal documents, contracts.
   - **Food Pickup**: Pickup from restaurants or home kitchens without built-in delivery.
   - **Cake Pickup**: Delicate handling and transport of bakery cakes and pastries.
   - **Medicine Pickup**: Urgent document or prescription pickup from medical centers.

4. **Personal & Shop Services (`personal`)**:
   - **Laundry**: Dry cleaning, wash & fold, iron press services.
   - **Tailoring**: Stitching, alterations, custom garment fitting.
   - **Salon**: Haircuts, styling, hair treatments.
   - **Beautician**: Facials, makeup, waxing, manicures, pedicures.
   - **Barber**: Beard trim, shaving, men's haircuts.
   - **Spa**: Massages, wellness therapy, relaxation packages.

title: PickPal Services Overview - Service Classification: Home Visit vs. Shop Visit
content:
In the PickPal system, services are categorized dynamically into two execution modes:
- **`HOME_SERVICE`**: Verified workers travel directly to the customer's specified location (e.g., Electrician, Plumber, Cleaning, AC Repair, Appliance Repair, Gardening, Grocery Run, Parcel Pick & Drop).
- **`VISIT_SHOP`**: Customers visit a physical partner shop or service center (e.g., Salon, Beautician, Barber, Spa, Laundry, Tailoring, Mobile/Laptop Repair, Dental Clinic, Garage).

title: PickPal Services Overview - Pricing & Fees Architecture
content:
- **Starting Price**: Base fee displayed on service discovery cards.
- **Inspection Fee**: Applicable for technical repair services (e.g., electrician, plumbing, AC repair) where final quotes are provided after on-site diagnostic.
- **Budget Cap**: For custom shopping errands, customers define a budget cap (`budgetCap`) to cap worker spending.
- **Pricing Note**: Not specified in the current PickPal system for unlisted custom items; custom prices are approved via checkout approvals in real time.

title: PickPal Shop Services Guide - Overview of Shop Services
content: Shop Services on PickPal represent services offered at physical vendor locations where customers visit the shop in person rather than requesting doorstep delivery.

title: PickPal Shop Services Guide - Categories of Shop Services
content:
- **Beauty & Grooming**: Salons, Barber Shops, Beauticians, Spa & Massage Parlors, Tattoo Studios.
- **Health & Wellness**: Local Medical Clinics, Dental Clinics, Optical Stores.
- **Apparel & Personal Care**: Tailoring & Alteration Shops, Laundromats & Dry Cleaners.
- **Vehicle Maintenance**: Garages, Bike Service Centers, Car Wash Depots.

title: PickPal Shop Services Guide - Booking Models for Shop Services
content:
PickPal supports two distinct shop booking models:

1. **Appointment Booking (Scheduled Time Slot)**:
   - Customer selects a specific date, time slot, and preferred staff partner at the shop.
   - Requires upfront booking details and generates an appointment confirmation.

2. **Salon Token Queue Booking (Digital Walk-In Token)**:
   - Designed for high-volume local shops (salons, barbers, clinics) to eliminate long physical waiting lines.
   - Customers request a digital queue token from home or while traveling.
   - Generates a digital ticket (e.g., Token `Q-18`) with real-time queue tracking.

title: PickPal Shop Services Guide - Shop Profile & Catalog Features
content:
- **Storefront Information**: Displays shop name, category, address, phone number, opening/closing hours, and overall rating.
- **Service Package List**: Displays individual services provided by the vendor along with prices, estimated durations, and assigned staff members.
- **Queue State Indicator**: Shows whether the shop's live digital queue is currently `active` or `paused`.

title: PickPal Shop Services Guide - Customer Visit & Verification Flow
content:
- When visiting the shop, the customer presents their digital ticket on the PickPal app.
- The ticket displays a check-in OTP verification code and an SVG QR code for fast vendor scanning.
- Once verified, the shop staff updates the token status to `in_progress` and subsequently `completed`.

title: PickPal Workers & Partners Guide - Worker Onboarding & Application Process
content: PickPal Delivery Partners and Service Workers are verified individuals who fulfill customer errand requests, home repairs, or shop service packages.

title: PickPal Workers & Partners Guide - Worker Profile & Categories
content:
- **Worker Types**:
  - `home_visit`: Technicians and errand runners traveling to customer locations.
  - `shop_service`: In-shop staff members providing salon, barber, spa, or tailoring services.
- **Service Categories**: Hardware, Groceries, Pharmacy, Electronics, Cleaning, Beauty, Courier/Pick & Drop.

title: PickPal Workers & Partners Guide - Onboarding & Identity Verification
content:
During registration, workers complete an identity verification application requiring:
1. **Government Identification Documents**:
   - Aadhaar Card Number (`aadhaarNumber`), Aadhaar Front Image (`aadhaarFront`), Aadhaar Back Image (`aadhaarBack`).
   - PAN Card Number (`panNumber`).
2. **Personal Verification**:
   - Clear Live Selfie photo (`selfie`).
   - Phone and Email OTP verification (`otpVerified`).
   - Address details, skills list, and prior experience.
3. **Banking Details for Payouts**:
   - Bank Account Number, IFSC Code, Account Holder Name, or UPI ID.

title: PickPal Workers & Partners Guide - Approval & Status Workflow
content:
- **Initial State**: Newly registered worker profiles receive `verificationStatus: "pending"` and `status: "pendingApproval"`.
- **Admin Audit**: Platform administrators audit uploaded identity proofs on the Admin Control Panel.
- **Approval / Rejection**:
  - If verified: Admin approves account (`status: "active"`, `verified: true`, `approvedAt: ISO timestamp`).
  - If rejected: Admin marks account (`verificationStatus: "rejected"`, `rejectionReason: "Reason string"`).

title: PickPal Workers & Partners Guide - Worker Operations & Availability
content:
1. **Online / Offline Toggle**:
   - Workers toggle their operational status using `isAvailable: true / false`.
   - When **Online**, worker GPS location is streamed and job offers appear on their dashboard feed.

2. **Operating Radius & Job Parameters**:
   - Workers define an operating radius (e.g., 5 km, 10 km).
   - Metrics tracked: `rating` (out of 5.0), `completedJobsCount`, `earnings` total, `pendingPayout`.

3. **Atomic Job Claiming**:
   - Workers view real-time pending jobs sorted by distance and rating matching scores.
   - Click **Claim Job** to claim an offer atomically via Firestore transaction.
